title: Positivity of a branched contract
statement: Let $M_0,M_1,M_2$ be machines, with $C_0$ a contract for $M_0$ from entry state $entry_0$ to the two exits $e_1,e_2$, where $e_1\ne e_2$, and let $C_1,C_2$ be contracts for $M_1,M_2$. Let $l_1,l_2$ map data for $C_0$ to data for $C_1,C_2$, respectively. Suppose that whenever an admissible $C_0$ endpoint has state $e_1$ (respectively, $e_2$), the endpoint with its state replaced by the entry state of $M_1$ (respectively, $M_2$) satisfies the corresponding branch contract's precondition. Then the branched contract has strictly positive assigned time for every datum and starting configuration satisfying its entry-state and precondition conditions.
hypotheses_covered: $C_0$ is a contract with entry $entry_0$ and exits $e_1,e_2$
Maps $l_1,l_2$ send $C_0$ data to the respective branch data
At an admissible endpoint in state $e_1$, the renamed endpoint satisfies the linked $C_1$ precondition
At an admissible endpoint in state $e_2$, the renamed endpoint satisfies the linked $C_2$ precondition
replaced:
Let $C_0$ be a contract for a machine with entry state $\mathrm{entry}_0$ and exits
$e_1,e_2$, where $e_1\ne e_2$. Let $C_1,C_2$ be contracts for the two branch machines,
and let $l_1,l_2$ map data for $C_0$ to data for those contracts. Suppose that whenever
$C_0$ ends in $e_1$, the corresponding state-renamed endpoint satisfies the $C_1$
precondition, and whenever it ends in $e_2$, the corresponding endpoint satisfies the
$C_2$ precondition. Then the branched contract has strictly positive running time on
every datum and starting configuration satisfying its entry-state and precondition
hypotheses.
